platformNote: Apple lookup and App Store compatibility metadata reviewed on 2026-11-20 verify iOS 18.6 or later for iPhone, iPadOS 18.6 or later for iPad, and macOS 15.6 or later for Mac. Keep chip evidence unavailable; do not infer Intel support, synchronization or identical controls across devices. The homepage includes real iPad staging outputs and a separate iPhone transcript sample; neither establishes a tested native Mac interface.
workflow: Paste a supported public video link up to 90 minutes. Transcribe speech in its original language or translate into 70 languages. From a completed, nonempty transcript, open Insight Studio and choose an output: short or detailed Standard or Professional summary, editable mind map, action checklist, step-by-step guide, study guide, quiz with explained answers or question-and-answer flashcards. Choose the output language, optionally customize the focus or context, review the displayed Insight cost and generate. The saved result opens in Outputs while Transcript remains available. Read, edit, copy and share text and notes. Processing continues after leaving the app and completion notifications are available.
limitations: Internet, Sign in with Apple for online processing and purchases, and consent for AI processing are required; processing consumes media minutes and Insight credits.

insightStudio.name: Insight Studio
insightStudio.flowSource: First-party Damas Swift interface source reviewed on 2026-11-20. The flow is conditional on a completed, nonempty transcript; toolbar presentation can vary with available space.
nativeFlow: Open a completed, nonempty transcript from Library. Open the wand-and-stars Insight Studio control; a wider toolbar shows its name, while a compact toolbar can use the icon with the Insight Studio accessibility label.
Insight Studio groups its output choices under Understand, Apply and Study. For a study guide, choose Study guide in Study; Quiz and Flashcards are separate choices.
Choose Output language. Customize is optional; Study guide offers Topic focus (optional) and Learning or exam objective (optional). Tailor to me is optional and requires a goal when enabled.
Review the displayed Insight cost, then choose Generate. This creates an AI output from the transcript; it does not require copying the transcript to another LLM.
A created saved output opens under Outputs. Transcript remains available. Review the output and its Source excerpt against the recording before relying on it; use Edit where that output offers it.
